verdict.rationale: Being an MCP client is a fair axis for a terminal app, since some terminals ship AI agents that consume MCP tools, but nothing in the evidence shows a-Shell can connect to or use MCP servers. Its documented programmatic surfaces are Apple Shortcuts actions, an optional local HTTPS relay, and a `.profile` startup script, none of which is an MCP client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
